title: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.15208v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seve

translated_title: PANINI-DR：通过生成式语义工作区实现受控深度研究
translated_abstract: 深度研究需要将搜索、推理和计算的多个步骤连接起来，中间发现的结果会引导下一步的调查方向。随着调查规模的扩大，智能体必须在多次模型调用之间维护研究状态，并在错误传播到后续工作之前对发现结果进行核验。我们提出了PANINI-DR，这是一个多智能体框架，它将整体调查的协调工作与各个子问题的研究和验证分离开来。一个基于生成式语义工作区（Generative Semantic Workspace）表示构建的共享工作区，用于记录子问题、它们的依赖关系、研究发现以及支持证据。研究者智能体负责调查各个子问题，而一个独立的验证智能体则依据这些子问题及其证据来核查所提出的答案。验证反馈会指导进一步的调查，记录下来的发现会为后续的任务分配提供依据。我们在BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES和MoNaCo数据集上对PANINI-DR进行了评估，并与若干（基线方法进行了对比）……
tldr: PANINI-DR提出了一种多智能体深度研究框架，通过基于生成式语义工作区的共享工作区记录子问题、依赖关系与证据，并将研究智能体与独立的验证智能体分离，从而实现对深度研究的受控协调与错误核验。
en_tdlr: PANINI-DR is a multi-agent deep research harness that uses a shared Generative Semantic Workspace to record subquestions, dependencies, and findings, separating research from independent verification agents to enable controlled, error-checked deep research.
